verdict.rationale: Asana publishes a dedicated Deprecations page describing its process: a clear description of each change, a migration plan, and a designated deprecation period during which callers can choose old or new behavior. The API signals upcoming changes through Asana-Change response headers, and callers can opt in or out per request with Asana-Enable and Asana-Disable headers, which works as feature-level versioning. Missing for 10: no evidence of explicitly numbered API versions (the v3 label refers to the Node SDK, not the API), no stated minimum deprecation notice length, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of how the policy works in practice.
